nangmandesert.tip.enjoy: If you really want to enjoy the game, try Hardcore!
nangmandesert.tip.mining: Digging in the desert doesn't seem like a good idea.
nangmandesert.tip.oasis: The happiness you feel when you find an oasis is incomparable to anything else.
nangmandesert.tip.puzzle: The pyramid puzzle can be solved with just one TNT.
nangmandesert.tip.pyramid: There is always a great treasure hidden in the center of the pyramid..
nangmandesert.tip.hot: Go into the water when it's too hot!
nangmandesert.tip.structures: It's easier to find structures in the flat desert!
